tools.name: homeassistant_list_entities
tools.description: List Home Assistant entities with their current state. Optionally filter by domain (e.g. light, switch, climate, cover, lock, fan, media_player, sensor, binary_sensor).

domain.description: Entity domain to filter by (optional). Examples: light, switch, climate, cover, lock

tools.name: homeassistant_get_state
tools.description: Get the full state and attributes of a single Home Assistant entity.

tools.name: homeassistant_call_service
tools.description: Call a Home Assistant service to control a device. Use this to turn devices on/off, toggle them, set temperature, lock/unlock, open/close covers, and more. IMPORTANT: When the user asks to control a SPECIFIC device by name, you MUST pass its entity_id. Only use area_id when the user asks about ALL devices in a room.

domain.description: Service domain, e.g. light, switch, climate, cover, lock, fan

service.description: Service name, e.g. turn_on, turn_off, toggle, set_temperature, lock, unlock, open_cover, close_cover

entity_id.description: Target a specific device by its entity ID (e.g. light.orb). Required when controlling a single named device — look it up first with homeassistant_list_entities. Only omit when targeting an entire area.

area_id.description: Target ALL devices of this domain in a room (e.g. 'living_room'). WARNING: this affects every matching device in the room, not a single device. Use the area_id shown by homeassistant_list_entities. Do NOT use when the user names a specific device.

service_data.description: Additional service parameters, e.g. {"temperature": 21} for climate or {"brightness_pct": 80} for lights

tools.name: homeassistant_set_state
tools.description: Change an attribute or setting on any Home Assistant device without needing to know the specific service call. Examples: dim a light (brightness=50), change HVAC mode (mode=cool), set fan speed (speed=75), position blinds (position=50), set thermostat temperature (temperature=21).

entity_id.description: The entity ID to change, e.g. light.orb, climate.living_room, fan.bedroom, cover.blinds

attribute.description: What to change. Lights: brightness, color_temp, rgb_color, state. Climate: temperature, mode, fan_mode, humidity. Cover: position, tilt_position. Fan: percentage/speed, preset_mode. Media player: volume, source. Vacuum: fan_speed/mode.

value.description: The new value. Use numbers for numeric attributes (e.g. brightness=50, temperature=21, position=50) and strings for modes (e.g. mode=cool, state=off).

tools.name: homeassistant_list_automations
tools.description: List all Home Assistant automations, scripts, and scenes that can be triggered by name.

tools.name: homeassistant_trigger_automation
tools.description: Trigger a Home Assistant automation, script, or scene by name or entity_id. Use homeassistant_list_automations first to find available options.

name.description: The friendly name (e.g. 'Goodnight Routine') or entity_id (e.g. 'automation.goodnight_routine') of the automation, script, or scene to trigger. Case-insensitive partial name matching is supported.

tools.name: homeassistant_set_timer
tools.description: Schedule a device to turn off after a delay. Examples: 'turn off the bedroom light in 30 minutes', 'turn off the TV in 2 hours'. Fires a plugin_set_timer event — requires a one-time automation setup in Home Assistant (instructions included in the response).

entity_id.description: The entity ID to turn off when the timer expires, e.g. light.bedroom_light, switch.tv

duration.description: How long to wait. Examples: '30m', '1h', '90s', '1h30m', '45 minutes', '2 hours'

tools.name: homeassistant_get_history
tools.description: Get the recent state history of a Home Assistant entity. Useful for questions like 'when did the kitchen light turn on?', 'how long was the front door open?', or 'what temperature was the thermostat set to this morning?'

entity_id.description: The entity ID to get history for, e.g. light.kitchen_light, binary_sensor.front_door

hours_back.description: How many hours of history to fetch (default: 24, max: 168). Use 0.5 for the last 30 minutes.
